T:P1.2.text: Whether you’re looking for complete flow assurance, industrial heating, temperature maintenance, freeze protection or environmental monitoring, Thermon has you covered

T:P1.4.text: World Leader In Industrial Process Heating

T:P1.6.text: Learn from Thermon engineers and product experts. Explore live sessions, visit us at industry events, or watch on-demand.

T:P1.7.text: From electric heat tracing to explosion-proof heaters, Thermon delivers engineered thermal solutions across every industry and environment.

T:P1.8.text: Electric heat, immersion, circulation, and specialty heaters for every industrial application.

T:P1.9.text: Electrical heat tracing cables, steam trace products, controls, and monitoring systems.

T:P1.10.text: Explosion-proof and rugged heating solutions engineered for the harshest transportation environments.

T:P1.11.text: General purpose and hazardous location power distribution panels and accessories for project sites.

T:P1.12.text: Electrically heated, steam, and pre-insulated tubing bundles with complete system accessories.

T:P1.13.text: Precision thermal management solutions designed to protect critical data center infrastructure.

T:P1.14.text: Heated flat blankets and container temperature control for custom industrial heating needs.

T:P1.15.text: Steam, hot water, and electrode boilers plus ancillary equipment for precision thermal processes.

T:P1.16.text: High-performance steam, hot oil, and hot water boilers with superheaters and ancillary systems.

T:P1.17.text: Our customers rely on us to provide high quality, safe, reliable and environmentally responsible solutions for their heating needs.

T:P1.18.text: Whether you’re looking for complete flow assurance, industrial heating, temperature maintenance, freeze protection or environmental monitoring, Thermon has you covered.

T:P1.19.text: We proudly celebrate our 70th anniversary! Since our founding in by Richard Burdick, Thermon has been dedicated to innovation in heat transfer solutions.

T:P1.20.text: From introducing heat transfer cement to pioneering the first packaged tracing systems and developing high-performance heating technologies, we’ve consistently pushed the boundaries to meet our customers’ needs

C:P1.1.text: Flowserve: Industrial Pumps, Valves, Seals & Actuators

C:P1.2.text: Flowserve moves, controls and protects the flow of materials in the world's most critical industries.

C:P1.3.text: We empower critical industries with extraordinary solutions.

C:P1.4.text: Flowserve manufactures and services pumps, valves, seals, and automation equipment that supports essential infrastructure around the world.

C:P1.5.text: Flowserve is committed to providing you with world-class support.

C:P1.6.text: Delivering a broader portfolio of engineered valve technologies, extensive nuclear valve solutions, and high‑quality OEM lifecycle services for the world’s most demanding, high‑consequence applications.

C:P1.7.text: Turbomachinery Lifecycle Expertise Now Part of Flowserve Services

C:P1.8.text: Introducing the LMX Cartridge Lip Seal for High‑Value Mixer Applications

C:P1.9.text: Flowserve has launched the LMX Cartridge Lip Seal — a carbon‑free, dry‑running sealing solution engineered specifically for demanding top‑entry mixers. Designed to help reduce contamination risk at its source, LMX delivers reliable performance when purity, precision and product integrity are on the line.

C:P1.10.text: Powering the Future of LNG Regasification

C:P1.11.text: Developed from decades of LNG expertise, the Cryogenic Submerged Motor Pump – High Pressure (HP) Series combines advanced cryogenic pumping technology with efficiency, reliability, and serviceability to help operators lower costs and improve long-term performance.

C:P1.12.text: Flowserve offers the world’s most comprehensive portfolio of flow control solutions. Our portfolio of pumps, valves, seals, actuation and instrumentation systems, and more is engineered to tackle our customers’ toughest challenges in fluid handling and control.

C:P1.13.text: Pumps ranging from standard to engineered, proven to handle your toughest

C:P1.14.text: Mechanical seal and sealing systems you can rely on for nearly any application.

C:P1.15.text: Valves engineered for performance and safety with precision control, optimized flow and fail-safe shut-off.

C:P1.16.text: The industry’s most complete range of actuators, positioners, controls, switches and accessories.

C:P1.17.text: The industry’s most energy-efficient solutions for SWRO desalination.

C:P1.18.text: We design reliable flow control equipment for use in a variety of industries including energy, nuclear power generation, chemical processing, and flood control facilities. Our application knowledge and technical expertise in flow control equipment enable us to help you with the toughest challenges you face in your application.

C:P1.19.text: Our solutions combine comprehensive flow control systems, innovative technology and world-wide aftermarket support to help optimize productivity, mitigate risks, and lower operating costs

C:P1.20.text: A complete flow control equipment monitoring solution using smart sensors, advanced analytics, and dedicated support to prevent failures and extend the life of your equipment.

C:P1.21.text: A system-wide analysis of your existing flow loops, tailored recommendations for energy savings opportunities, and solutions to optimize your system performance.

C:P2.2.text: Flowserve’s heritage brands, with over two centuries of innovation, provide reliable solutions in pumps, seals, valves, and IoT. Trusted globally for critical applications and backed by world-class service.

C:P3.2.text: Flowserve's application knowledge and technical expertise enable reliable flow control equipment you can trust in the most aggressive environments.

C:P3.3.text: At Flowserve you will find a deep application expertise that spans a variety of industries.
